null_model.name: per-dimension configuration model
null_model.preserves: each work's own number of values on that dimension, and the dimension's per-value prevalence
null_model.does_not_preserve: correlations between values inside a work, so the excess here is an upper bound on any structure attributed to a dimension whose detector fires on co-occurring strings
null_model.pair_set: each population's chance line is drawn over the same pairs as the observed mean it subtracts: the complete graph over the works that carry a value for the dimension, and for the scored graph the scorable subset the comparison layer actually pools. See `pair_graph.chance_line_conditioning` for how much the conditioning is worth.
null_model.why_not_a_permutation: the mean over a complete graph is invariant to permuting which work owns which set, so a label-shuffled control would return the observed number and call it a null
null_model.why_not_a_co_occurrence_preserving_permu: tested and set aside: resampling whole observed value sets across works leaves the null's expectation equal to the observed complete-graph mean for every live dimension, so the excess it produces is zero by construction rather than a measurement against an independent baseline

carrier_graph.how_to_read_it: the corpus flags this many dimensions; a corpus drawn from the same marginals with no structure in it flags this many on average, and flags at least one this often. A count of flagged dimensions is evidence against that second number, not against zero. The Monte Carlo column is the tighter reading: it asks how many of the null's own draws sit at or beyond the observed excess, so a dimension whose excess is larger than the band but smaller than the null's usual scatter is reported as flagged by the band and not separated from chance by the draws.
carrier_graph.what_this_does_not_do: it is not a test at a declared alpha, and it corrects nothing about the dependence between dimensions, which this null assumes away in exactly the same way the chance line does; it sizes the band, it does not replace it

chance_line_conditioning.primary_line: drawn over the pairs the observed mean was measured on, which for this graph is the scorable subset and not the complete graph
chance_line_conditioning.reading: conditioning the line on the scored pairs moves every chance line by at most 0.00982 against a band of 0.05, and it moves 2 of 18 band verdicts. The excesses are not an artefact of which pair set the baseline was drawn on, but a band-edge dimension is a band-edge dimension under either construction and should not be reported as a discovery on the strength of one

pair_graph.why_a_second_population: the model comparison refuses a pair below the declared minimum comparable keys, so the means it pools are measured over 1237 of 2080 pairs covering 52 of 65 works, and a work rich enough to be scored is not a random work. On this corpus the observed mean of `D4_cosmic_function`, read as `declared_rule`, moves 0.098787 between the carrier graph and the scored graph — further than the 0.05 this scan uses to call an excess indistinguishable from chance. So a chance line has to name the graph it was drawn on before anyone subtracts it, and the chance numbers below come from the scored graph alone. This is the population the M4 block-profile test reads.

sensitivity_under_the_endorsement_frame.why: a block ordering that flips between the candidate frame and the endorsement frame is not a fact about the traditions; the two frames differ only in how loudly the detector fired

pairs.reading: a high pair is a candidate for a shared transmission route, not evidence of one; and the inverted list is the shape M4 says should be rare, so it is the list a reviewer should read first

what_this_is_not: no dates, so no transmission claim; detector output over English translations, not human coding; works are not independent, so dependence is flagged per pair rather than filtered away; the chance line comes from the corpus's own marginals, drawn over the pair set of the population it is subtracted from, and it preserves nothing but the per-value prevalence and each work's set size
